messages.author: ed19f725ef2a1e0c
messages.subject: useR2007 application
parts:
Am digging rapache.

Thanks for making this.

Very cool.

Have success getting the helloworld , Rapacheinfo(), and Rapachetest
examples working on my local webserver.

Am getting stumped while getting the useR2007 application working.

Downloaded the example, added the directory directives to httpd.conf

type in http://127.0.0.1/brew/useR2007brew/brew/useR2007.rhtml and
everything is cool.

Then I change one of the GET params (mo, p1, or p2) and get this
message:

RApache Warning/Error!!!

Error in function (file = stdin(), output = stdout(), text = NULL,
envir = parent.frame(), : No valid input
RApache Warning/Error!!!

Error calling function brew!

Thought it was a www-data permissions issue on my /var/www/images
directory.

No success messing with this though.

Any other ideas?

Please advise.

Great work!

messages.author: ed19f725ef2a1e0c
messages.subject: Re: useR2007 application
parts:
Problem solved.

Ajax.updater error in userR2007.js

function Replot()

was pointing to the wrong directory for useR2007plot.rhtml.

new Ajax.Updater( 'plot', 'make sure this directory path is
correct/useR2007plot.rhtml',
